sentences.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun whereby applicants are facing trial for the offences punishable under Section 323, 498A, 504 IPC read with Section 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station - Raipur, District - Dehradun.

3. Brief facts of the case that applicant no. 3 married with the respondent no. 2 on 10.12.2020,
however, some differences arose between them due to which they are living separately since 18.11.2021 and there is no issue from the marriage.
4.

It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant no. 3 is husband and respondent no. 2 is wife and applicant no. 3 intended to live with his wife and that is reason, he filed a suit for restitution of conjugal rights in the court of Judge, Family Court, Kotdwar bearing Matrimonial Suit No. 90 of 2025 under Section 29 of the Uniform Civil Code.
